limitations: The reviewer read only the shuffled packet and its eight referenced original photos; implementation, version metadata, prior annotations and previous judgments were withheld.
Warning text itself may suggest a design approach; masking cannot guarantee which version a reviewer might infer.
Same-model review is not a human review or a measured accuracy determination.
Useful means contextual review value, not verification of a numerical guideline, grams or calories.
This review predates the later herb/grouped-item class changes; do not reuse its labels automatically for reworded/new warnings.
